hero.tagline: Your Third Eye — Open-Source Assistive Vision for Nepal
hero.description: Trinetra provides real-time spoken guidance for blind, low-vision, deaf, and hard-of-hearing individuals. Runs completely on-device with zero cloud latency and total privacy.

downloads.title: Downloads & Installation
downloads.subtitle: Choose your platform. Everything runs offline on your own hardware.
downloads.noReleaseNotice: No binary installer has been published yet. Follow the source build guide or download the firmware below.

windows.title: Windows Desktop
windows.subtitle: Standalone 64-bit installer with embedded offline vision engine.
windows.requirements: Requires Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit). No GPU required.

android.title: Android Mobile
android.subtitle: Installable Progressive Web App (PWA) with high-contrast UI.
android.step1: Open this website in Google Chrome on your Android phone.
android.step2: Tap the browser menu (⋮) in the top-right corner.
android.step3: Tap 'Install app' or 'Add to Home screen' and confirm.
android.apkNote: Direct offline APK will be available once the mobile build is signed.

ios.title: Apple iOS (iPhone / iPad)
ios.subtitle: Safari Progressive Web App with screen reader & VoiceOver integration.
ios.step1: Open this website in Safari on your iPhone or iPad.
ios.step2: Tap the Share button (square icon with an upward arrow) at the bottom.
ios.step3: Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen', then tap 'Add' to confirm.

firmware.title: ESP32-CAM Wearable Firmware
firmware.subtitle: Open-source Arduino sketch for chest-mount or spectacle camera streaming.
firmware.instructions: Flash to an AI-Thinker ESP32-CAM module using Arduino IDE at 115200 baud over 2.4GHz Wi-Fi.

howItWorks.title: How Trinetra Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From raw visual input to spoken Nepali guidance in three real-time steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Streams real-time frames from your computer webcam or a lightweight wearable ESP32-CAM.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Neural models analyze ground drop-offs, dangling cables, bus route boards, and Nepali currency offline.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Speaks immediate directional warnings in natural Nepali and renders visual subtitles for deaf users.

status.title: What Works Today — Real & Honest Status
status.subtitle: Assistive software must be completely honest about its capabilities. Every metric below is calibrated from held-out benchmark splits.
status.benchmarksNote: Benchmarks: Currency top-1 baseline accuracy is 17.4% on worn physical notes (safely gated with spoken uncertainty at 0.70 confidence). Devanagari OCR Character Error Rate (CER) is 1.0157 with 3.1% exact match on weathered street signs (gated at 0.45 confidence).

privacy.title: Accessibility & Privacy by Design
privacy.subtitle: Built specifically for users with visual, auditory, and mobility impairments.
privacy.offlineDesc: All computer vision, speech synthesis, and QR parsing execute locally on your CPU. No camera feed or audio ever leaves your computer.
privacy.screenReaderDesc: Tested with NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, and TalkBack. Features semantic landmarks, single h1 hierarchy, and aria-live announcements.
privacy.keyboardDesc: Every button, link, and control is fully accessible via Tab and Enter keys, with unmistakable high-visibility focus indicators.
privacy.contrastDesc: Full compliance with system high-contrast modes (forced-colors) and zero-motion preferences for vestibular sensitivity.

changelog.title: Changelog & Releases
changelog.subtitle: Directly mirrored from our official releases repository.
